root_cause: This is a recurrence of the long-standing intermittent primType-reporting flake in the CPU functional test suite (signature 76751669c7a78fcd, previously seen with i8/u8 ARM64 ACL conversions). The assertion in cpu_test_utils.cpp:248 compares the runtime-reported IMPL_TYPE exec-graph attribute (primType) against the statically expected selectedType ('ref_u2' here); occasionally the executor graph reports 'unknown_<type>' instead of the real implementation tag, independent of which Convert precision pair is under test. PR #39387 only touches the PyTorch FX decoder input-naming logic (fx_decoder.py, input_model.cpp) and its own Python frontend test file; it has no relation to the CPU plugin's Convert executor or exec-graph metadata reporting, confirming the failure is unrelated to this PR's changes.
reproduction_steps: Run: ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter=*smoke_ConvertCPULayerTest_from_u2*CompareWithRefs*inputPRC=u2*targetPRC=i32*primitive=ref* on ARM64; failure is intermittent under the 16-worker parallel test runner and may not reproduce on every attempt.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed CPU functional tests job; this is an unrelated, previously documented intermittent primType-reporting flake
Investigate why the exec-graph IMPL_TYPE attribute can report 'unknown_<prc>' instead of the real implementation name for low-bit Convert kernels (u2/i8/u8) in src/plugins/intel_cpu
Consider quarantining or relaxing the primTypeCheck assertion for low-bit (sub-byte) Convert precisions until the exec-graph metadata population race is fixed
prevention_strategies: Track recurrence of signature 76751669c7a78fcd across precisions (now observed for i8/u8 and u2 Convert variants); prioritize root-causing the exec-graph IMPL_TYPE population race in the CPU plugin so 'unknown' is never reported for a successfully dispatched primitive.
historical_context: Same normalized signature (primType is unexpected unknown Expected ref, category Flaky Test) previously recorded on 2026-07-17 (run 29552704755, PR #36890) for an i8->u8 ACL Convert variant, and a near-identical ACL-prefixed pattern (primtype is unexpected unknown expected acl) recurred 9 times between 2026-09-11 and 2026-11-13 across MaxPool/AvgPool/FC/Convert smoke tests on ARM64. This confirms a broader, still-unresolved ARM64 exec-graph primitive-reporting flake affecting multiple unrelated PRs over several months.
